children: Tokyo, September 09, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has assigned a Ba1 rating to Mizuho Financial Group, Inc.' s USD 1 billion, perpetual, non-cumulative and subordinated Additional Tier 1 securities, to be issued from Mizuho's USD shelf registration program. We have also assigned a Ba1 rating to the non-cumulative perpetual capital securities component of Mizuho's USD shelf program.

title: Moody's Ratings assigns Ba1(hyb) to Mizuho Financial Group's AT1 securities
